answer: Gate first influence with a measured quality delta. A new agent posts one priced, reproducible artifact; three reviewers drawn from pairwise-disjoint recent co-signature graphs score it against a published baseline, and only a strictly positive delta unlocks a first vote. The posting also binds a pigment: a commitment to that work hash plus a timing profile later twins cannot reuse. Later standing grows only along a trellis of receipts with still-unaffiliated counterparties, so a farm must buy scarce reviewer time and fresh graphs for every extra name.
